title: Discovering Obscure Looking Glass Sites on the Web to Facilitate Internet Measurement Research
mechanism: Focused crawler and positive-unlabeled classifier expand measurement vantage points.
result: The tool retrieves 910 obscure automatable Looking Glass vantage points.
evaluation: Crawler experiments and an AS-topology case study; a research measurement asset, not a Tencent product KPI.
implication: Broader external visibility can improve measurement coverage; production adoption by Tencent is not established.

title: Accessing Cloud with Disaggregated Software-Defined Router
mechanism: Separate cloud-router access, forwarding, routing and SDN-control modules so they scale independently.
result: Authors report years of operational experience supporting growth in cloud access traffic.
evaluation: Production architecture and operational account; the abstract does not supply a single comparable improvement ratio.
implication: The plausible advantage is feature velocity and independent scaling instead of proprietary-router dependence.

title: Detecting Ephemeral Optical Events with OpTel
mechanism: Vendor-agnostic streaming optical telemetry with controller-side data management.
result: One-second telemetry detects twice as many optical events; six months of backbone use are reported.
evaluation: Comparison to existing telemetry systems, plus production observations; event detection is not equivalent to outage reduction.
implication: Fine-grained operational data is a reusable capability for later reliability work.

title: Elixir: A High-performance and Low-cost Approach to Managing Hardware/Software Hybrid Flow Tables Considering Flow Burstiness
mechanism: Burst-aware measurement and replacement policies manage hybrid hardware/software flow tables.
result: Experiments report up to about 50% less software CPU use and about 97.6% lower tail forwarding latency than the evaluated alternatives.
evaluation: ConnectX-5/P4-switch prototypes and real traffic traces; this is not an all-fleet production saving.
implication: Better use of scarce offload-table capacity can reduce fallback CPU cost.

title: Boomerang: Metadata-Private Messaging under Hardware Trust
mechanism: Secure enclaves and oblivious shuffling hide communication metadata under an explicit hardware trust assumption.
result: A 32-machine evaluation reports 7.76-second p99 latency for roughly one million clients.
evaluation: Research-system evaluation; secure-enclave trust and messaging latency are essential qualifiers. The collected HTML renders the client exponent imperfectly; the report does not use it as a headline metric.
implication: A distinct privacy research connection, not evidence of a deployed consumer-messaging feature.
first_author_institutions: City University of Hong Kong; Wuhan University

title: Enabling High Quality Real-Time Communications with Adaptive Frame-Rate
mechanism: Adapt frame rate jointly to network fluctuation and client decoder capacity.
result: Reported reductions reach 7.4× for tail queuing delay and average stuttering reduction of 34%; production use exceeds one year.
evaluation: Trace-driven simulations and in-the-wild deployment; benefits concern specified end-to-end delay and decoder queues.
implication: QoE improves by controlling the producer and decoder pipeline, not only the network.

title: FlexWAN: Software Hardware Co-design for Cost-Effective and Resilient Optical Backbones
mechanism: Co-design spacing-variable optical hardware, centralized vendor-agnostic control and capacity planning.
result: The paper reports at least 57% fewer transponders and 36% less spectrum usage in its evaluated settings.
evaluation: Production experience and capacity-planning comparisons; hardware savings are not directly Tencent's total WAN expenditure reduction.
implication: Optical flexibility creates a plausible capex and resilience lever; absolute fleet-wide savings are unknown.

title: TENSOR: Lightweight BGP Non-Stop Routing
mechanism: Kernel-modification-free primary/backup BGP replication in lightweight virtualized components.
result: Two-year operation on 400 servers and over 31,000 BGP peerings; reported development/deployment/maintenance cost factors are 20×/5×/10× versus the paper's router approach.
evaluation: Operational cost estimates and testbed comparisons; cost factors have different denominators and must not be multiplied.
implication: Programmable reliability may lower operational friction while retaining non-stop routing.

title: AUGUR: Practical Mobile Multipath Transport Service for Low Tail Latency in Real-Time Streaming
mechanism: Choose retransmission timing and Wi-Fi/cellular paths using per-session models and optimization.
result: Reported improvements reach 66.0% lower tail latency, 99.5% lower frame stall rate and 88.1% less cellular data use than compared multipath schemes.
evaluation: Trace-driven emulation and Tencent START deployment; these are conditional maxima against selected baselines.
implication: Tail-latency control must also respect the user's cellular-data budget.

title: Hairpin: Rethinking Packet Loss Recovery in Edge-based Interactive Video Streaming
mechanism: Differentiate redundancy for initial transmissions and retransmissions across multiple rounds.
result: Production experiments report average reductions of 40% in bandwidth cost and 32% in deadline misses.
evaluation: In-the-wild comparisons to the paper's state-of-the-art baselines; packet/frame deadline definitions matter.
implication: QoE and network cost can improve together when retransmission semantics are modeled.
first_author_institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; Tencent; Tsinghua University

title: Pudica: Toward Near-Zero Queuing Delay in Congestion Control for Cloud Gaming
mechanism: Probe bandwidth utilization using paced video frames and control bitrate to avoid self-induced queues.
result: The paper reports 3.1×/4.9× reductions in average/tail frame delay, a 10.3× stall-rate reduction and 12.1% higher frame bitrate.
evaluation: Real-network evaluation and deployment serving millions of players; the ratios refer to different QoE measures.
implication: Application pacing gives the congestion controller information generic bulk-transfer schemes lack.

title: MegaTE: Extending WAN Traffic Engineering to Millions of Endpoints in Virtualized Cloud
mechanism: Bottom-up asynchronous TE queries, eBPF segment routing and optimization contraction reach virtual-instance granularity.
result: The paper reports 20× more endpoints at similar algorithm runtime and up to 51% lower real-time packet latency in production analysis.
evaluation: Flow-level simulations and Tencent rollout since December 2022; algorithm scale and application latency are separate comparisons.
implication: Fine-grained virtual-cloud control extends WAN infrastructure into tenant-level policy.

title: Turbo: Efficient Communication Framework for Large-scale Data Processing Cluster
mechanism: Block-level flowlets, non-blocking middleware and reliable fallback improve RDMA shuffle.
result: Large-cluster results report 23.9% lower job completion time and 2.03× job completion rate than existing RDMA solutions.
evaluation: Apache Spark integration, small testbed and hundreds-of-servers production cluster; this is data-processing communication, not automatically LLM research.
implication: Infrastructure value appears as useful completed work, not just link bandwidth.

title: Holmes: Localizing Irregularities in LLM Training with Mega-scale GPU Clusters
mechanism: Use abnormal communication operators and cross-iteration dependency graphs to localize silent training slowdowns.
result: Trace-driven simulation reaches 97.21% localization accuracy; a production-level prototype localizes irregularity within 30.3 seconds.
evaluation: The 97.21% accuracy is simulation, while the timing is a prototype measurement; neither alone proves fleet-wide realized training savings.
implication: Silent stragglers are an economic target even when GPUs do not fail outright.

title: Unlocking ECMP Programmability for Precise Traffic Control
mechanism: A compiler/runtime exposes constrained ECMP-group control for deterministic per-flow path actions.
result: The paper evaluates at scale and reports one use case deployed in a live datacenter.
evaluation: Simulation plus one production use case; precise control is not evidence that ECMP randomness is eliminated globally.
implication: Control-plane abstractions can extract more value from existing switching features.

title: Astral: A Datacenter Infrastructure for Large Language Model Training at Scale
mechanism: Co-design same-rail interconnection, power/cooling, hierarchical monitoring and operator-level forecasting.
result: An 18-month rollout supporting LLM training and inference for multiple customers is reported.
evaluation: Production experience spans physical infrastructure and software; potential scale mentioned elsewhere in the paper is not its demonstrated deployed GPU count.
implication: The competitive mechanism is stack coordination and operability rather than one isolated transport algorithm.

title: Fornax: A Hardware-Centric Session Management in Large Public Cloud Network
mechanism: Hardware-centric session management replaces one-way software flow programming with bidirectional protocols.
result: Testbed reductions of 80% software storage and 77% CPU use; production management of up to 16 million sessions is reported.
evaluation: Separate testbed resource comparisons and large-scale production observations; not a whole-server cost ratio.
implication: Management-plane efficiency is increasingly important as hardware offload tables grow.

title: PreTE: Traffic Engineering with Predictive Failures
mechanism: Translate ephemeral optical degradation into dynamic failure probabilities, pre-created tunnels and traffic allocation.
result: Large-scale simulation supports up to twice the demand at the same availability level as the evaluated schemes.
evaluation: Production-level WAN testbed for runtime feasibility plus simulation for demand/availability benefit; a production-wide 2× traffic gain is not established.
implication: An optical-telemetry-to-control loop is a plausible knowledge advantage; direct code lineage from OpTel is not proven.

title: A Composable Emulation Framework for Whitebox Switches
mechanism: Adaptor-based interface contracts compose data-plane, control-plane and peripheral switch emulators.
result: Reported 2.2× forwarding-emulation performance; operators used the system for 97.5% of 203 issues in a recent year.
evaluation: Emulator performance and operator-use coverage; the percentage is not an outage-reduction measurement.
implication: Reproducible failure diagnosis can shorten iteration cycles across heterogeneous hardware.

title: BLADE: Adaptive Wi-Fi Contention Control for Next-Generation Real-Time Communication
mechanism: Distributed adaptive Wi-Fi contention windows target packet-delivery droughts at the access point.
result: Under heavy contention, tail packet latency falls by over 5×; cloud-gaming stall rate falls by over 90% in the evaluated settings.
evaluation: NS3 simulation and commercial AP experiments; distinguish controlled Wi-Fi results from an Internet-wide production rollout.
implication: A transport-only solution cannot remove a MAC-layer bottleneck; practical rollout requires AP access.

title: Cost-effective and Reliable Global Internet Peering with Programmable Switches
mechanism: Programmable-switch peering offloads inbound/outbound traffic, redirects suspicious traffic and accelerates route convergence.
result: The paper reports 78% lower average hardware cost than its existing-system comparison and seconds-scale route convergence.
evaluation: Gradual production rollout and evaluated failure scenarios; hardware cost is not total ownership cost.
implication: Commodity programmability aligns peering cost, DDoS handling and routing flexibility.

title: DDoS Detection at the Scale of One Hundred Tbps
mechanism: Combine dynamic load balancing across detection servers with programmable-switch traffic compression.
result: The authors report scaling DDoS detection beyond 100 Tbps in real deployments.
evaluation: Distributed detection scale and production deployment; volume capacity does not by itself establish detection precision or business loss avoided.
implication: A security service can exploit the same programmable-network systems expertise as gateways.
first_author_institutions: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen; Tencent

title: From Source to Solution: Tackling Packet Losses in Large-scale Cloud Gaming Systematically and Precisely
mechanism: Diagnose loss sources and combine loss avoidance, RACK-TLP detection and opportunistic FEC recovery.
result: A one-year Tencent START rollout reports 0.049% packet loss and 99.87% of frames delivered within 100 ms.
evaluation: Production observations; the reported 59.8% packet-loss reduction uses the paper's existing-solution baseline, not a controlled revenue experiment.
implication: The all-Tencent paper shows that internal operational diagnosis complements the academic-heavy portfolio.

title: Harp: Improving VPC Network Availability via Efficient Failure Detection and Rerouting in Tencent Cloud
mechanism: Host software monitors feasible physical paths and moves flows to healthy alternatives without special hardware.
result: Over two years in Tencent Cloud; reported outage-time reductions range from 78.71% to 99.97% with sub-second failed-path bypass.
evaluation: Production failure cases; the broad percentage range depends on scenario and is not a single availability SLA.
implication: Software path resilience may extract reliability from an existing fabric without a hardware refresh.

title: MirrorNet: High-fidelity and Scalable Network Emulation for Software-defined WAN
mechanism: Replay historical controller, forwarding and traffic state in a scalable production-aligned WAN twin.
result: The abstract reports over two years of TWAN use for troubleshooting, tuning, testing and capacity assessment.
evaluation: Production operational account; no direct causal incident-reduction estimate is supplied in the abstract.
implication: An executable copy of the network can turn operational knowledge into repeatable tests.

title: SwiftEP: Accelerating MoE Inference with Buffer Fusion and TMA Offloading
mechanism: Buffer fusion and TMA offload reduce MoE all-to-all copies and GPU SM consumption.
result: On 16/32 GPUs, up to 119.7% higher algorithm bandwidth, 66.7% lower SM occupancy and 21.2% higher serving capacity versus DeepEP are reported.
evaluation: Small-cluster comparison with a specified library; no fleet-scale production deployment is established by the abstract.
implication: Freeing compute and memory-movement resources can matter as much as faster wire communication.

title: CubeTrace: Microscopic Network Tracing for Heterogeneous Cloud Gateways
mechanism: Normalize functions across heterogeneous gateway hardware into tracing cubes and decode them for standard tracing tools.
result: The abstract reports under 1% memory/latency overhead and localization reduced from hours or days to minutes.
evaluation: Gateway deployment and author-reported diagnostic experience; the before/after times are not a uniform benchmark across incidents.
implication: Observability follows offload complexity into individual functions, not just network devices.
first_author_institutions: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

title: DistDPU: A Disaggregated DPU Architecture for High-Performance and Cost-Efficient AI Clouds
mechanism: Separate bandwidth-provisioning execution modules from a shared control-centric orchestration module.
result: The abstract reports two years in production serving over 10,000 GPUs.
evaluation: Official abstract and publisher metadata; final PDF is unavailable locally, so detailed cost ratios and institutional task ownership are not asserted.
implication: Independent control/data scaling targets the mismatch between elephant-flow bandwidth and relatively flat control demand.

title: Dorado: Scaling SmartNIC Session Tables on Commodity DDRs
mechanism: Restructure session layouts, pipelines and memory scheduling to use commodity DDR instead of costly advanced memory.
result: The abstract reports 16-million-entry tables, 80% lower memory cost and 50 Mpps processing, with deployment over three years.
evaluation: Official abstract and publisher deposit; a 33% testbed packet-rate improvement is separate from memory-cost savings. Final PDF access and three program-affiliation conflicts remain caveats.
implication: Memory organization, not simply a faster NIC, can be an offload cost lever.

title: Pegasus: A Data Center Network for Bare-Metal AI Cloud
mechanism: One DPU virtualizes multiple RNICs; offloaded per-packet balancing and credit control serve multi-tenant bare-metal AI.
result: The abstract reports more than two years of production use covering 8,000 GPUs.
evaluation: Official abstract and publisher deposit; final PDF is not locally retrievable and this scale cannot be added to DistDPU's GPU count without checking overlap.
implication: Tenant isolation and communication performance become a joint architecture problem.

title: Rethinking Cloud Optimization: Volatility-Driven for Better Outcomes
mechanism: Aggregate temporally complementary workloads to reduce volatility before oversubscription.
result: Using CPU as the representative resource, experiments report 43.3% lower MCV and 66.74% higher oversubscription profit.
evaluation: Experimental objective under evaluated workloads, not observed Tencent company profit; networking-boundary candidate.
implication: A useful adjacent cloud-efficiency signal, but not evidence of a network-mechanism contribution.
first_author_institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

title: XFir: Accelerating New-Flow Setup on Host Servers of a Large Cloud Network
mechanism: Move new-flow setup to a DPU cloud-network coprocessor while retaining CPU collaboration and software flexibility.
result: The abstract reports over 776K new-flow CPS at 11.7 microseconds, with 4.8× CPS and 69.2% less latency versus Fornax.
evaluation: Specified host-server comparison, not total fleet throughput; CPS is connections per second, not packets per second. Final PDF includes all 18 authors.
implication: The next bottleneck shifts from table capacity to flexible slow-path connection setup.
